tasks.name: Reaction classification
tasks.permitted_inputs: Recorded reactant and product strings; class labels withheld.
tasks.failure_policy: Freeze source-field eligibility before prediction. Report attempted, valid and failed predictions against all eligible records. Classification/set/mechanism recovery counts missing or invalid outputs as misses. Regression and probability metrics require finite valid outputs; report their paired denominator and failure fraction explicitly rather than silently assigning failures a numeric value.
tasks.grouping_scope: Recorded source chemical keys where provided, exact reaction-text keys otherwise. No universal chemical or source independence claim.

proposed_split.meaning: Candidate deterministic allocation by group key; not claimed as a published benchmark protocol.

tasks.source_split_policy: Retain recorded source split separately; expert feasibility labels remain held out.
tasks.units: Source-native categorical labels or recorded molecular fragment sets; no physical energy units apply.
tasks.execution_scope: Data export only; benchmark execution deferred

metric_reporting.classification: Accuracy and macro F1 are computed per recorded label field; no averaging across incompatible hierarchies. B/U refers to balanced/unbalanced reaction equations, not class proportions.
metric_reporting.clustering: ARI and NMI use external reference labels only after assignments are fixed. Any label-informed cluster count or tuning must be disclosed.
metric_reporting.regression: MAE and RMSE use source-specific target scales; yield R2 additionally requires nonzero reference variance. Missing/invalid outputs have a separate failure rate and paired denominator.
metric_reporting.feasibility: Positive label is 1. AUROC/AUPRC require both classes and finite probabilities. Balanced accuracy uses a predeclared threshold (default 0.5); calibration uses Brier score with the probability denominator and evidence tier reported separately.
metric_reporting.sets: Split recorded molecular-set labels on dot separators, remove exact duplicate fragments, retain recorded spelling. No implicit chemical canonicalization or stereochemical equivalence is claimed. Exact-match and F1 calculations require a declared tokenization; unknown roles are masked.
metric_reporting.mechanism: Use synrxn.metrics.mechanism with the frozen typed records and allowed EXACT/NORMALIZED primary tiers. Top-k 1,3,5; supplied endpoints make net agreement diagnostic. DELTA_CONSISTENT remains diagnostic-only.
